name: frequency-fresh-confirmation-blocked-audit-20260924
purpose: Metadata-only pre-release blocker audit for the explicitly requested ten-family frequency confirmation. Conditional release is refused; no family is excluded or substituted and no margin is weakened.

blocker.reasoning: The published official task is stratified 10-fold CV and its smallest class has exactly 60 rows. Under that stated stratification the class contributes six held-out rows per fold, below the frozen minimum of ten. Overall support >=30 and training support >=20 do not cure the selected-test shortfall.
blocker.certainty_limit: This is a contradiction with the published metadata protocol, not a claim that actual split-index/label payloads were inspected. Release cannot certify the required margin from this evidence.
blocker.action: Stop for parent resolution of the protocol constraint BEFORE acquisition. Do not lower the threshold, change this family's task/fold, drop it or substitute another family autonomously.

requested_protocol_not_executable.expected_cells_formula: (8 official tasks * 1 selected split + 2 UCI IID tasks * 3 folds) * 4 methods * 4 learners * 1 seed

featcopilot-frequency-paired.scope: The same existing named implementation for every dataset/task/learner; no new accuracy logic or post-outcome switches.

method_semantics_documentation_only.references: openfe-inductive-native and autofeat-native keep native output widths without the candidate's 50-feature cap; no error-to-baseline fallback.
method_semantics_documentation_only.catboost_selection_disclosure: The existing candidate selection estimator is reconstructed without cat_features and uses the candidate engine's numeric preprocessing. The final CatBoost pipeline retains its native categorical handling; selection and downstream representations differ. This is disclosed, not silently changed.
method_semantics_documentation_only.binding: These descriptions are not runtime overrides. Exact method names, shared config, declared learner searches and source/run identities are the operative bindings.

decision_gates.pairing: Arithmetic mean of scheduled split losses per family/method/learner, then equal-family relative loss improvement for aggregate comparisons.
decision_gates.positive_vs_raw: Mean relative improvement versus raw strictly >0 in every classification/regression x learner stratum.
decision_gates.family_harm: No family/learner loss increase >5% versus raw.
decision_gates.strong_references: Mean paired relative improvement >=0 versus EACH complete paired native reference in every task/learner stratum.
decision_gates.completion: Every planned cell must succeed with finite comparable loss; failures, timeouts, RSS kills or missing pairs block broad claims.
decision_gates.win_tie_loss: Family-level relative improvement >1% is win, <-1% loss, otherwise tie.
decision_gates.intervals: Descriptive family-block intervals only; not a significance guarantee or automatic promotion/SOTA authorization.
decision_gates.scope: Ten fixed observational origins, bounded selected official split0 and three UCI IID folds; not a full leaderboard or all-modality SOTA claim.

requested_protocol_not_executable.budget_scope: 24h ceiling under the parent-reported remaining allowance; no execution authorized by this audit. Full 224 x 900s timeout usage would be 56h, so completion under the ceiling is not guaranteed.

exposure_check.conclusion: No selected model exposure is recorded, but the class-support blocker prevents release and prevents any unknown-to-audited_unexposed transition.

source_review.rights: Previously audited primary grants remain unchanged. No new payload processing or broader permission was exercised.
